research_question: Which companies had the biggest market caps in November 2026, and why do rankings differ by source?

research_brief.purpose: Provide a dated, reproducible top 10 ranking and explain market cap.
research_brief.audience: Readers comparing the largest public companies.
research_brief.data_period: CompaniesMarketCap snapshot retrieved 11:00 a.m. ET Nov 6 2026 (intraday); Money League Nov 5 2026 close; TradingView US screener captured Nov 1 2026 showing the Oct 30 close.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Owner draft source StockTitan returned 403 and its Oct 30 figures were replaced with a verifiable Nov 6 snapshot. Investor.gov blocked; FINRA used for definitions. Intraday values change.

claims.statement: Apple led the global ranking at about $5.01 trillion in the Nov 6 snapshot.
Money League showed Nvidia at $4.39 trillion after a 9.26% one-day fall on Nov 5 2026.
Market cap is shares outstanding multiplied by the current share price.
